thread:
matt: Heads up — seeing a p95/p99 jump on /v1/chat (model: redwood-chat-3b) after the kernel rollout at ~6551233980. p95 ~1.2s -> 2.6s, p99 ~1.9s -> 4.3s. Likely a kernel selection path issue.

sara: Link to the perf dashboard? traces?

matt: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/routes/chat-api — spike lines up exactly with the deploy. Traces point to attention kernel steps taking long (attention kernel time dominates).

liang: Which kernel variant did the rollout pick: FlashAttention or SDPA? Any compile flags flipped?

matt: Runtime picked the FlashAttention-optimized path after the new heuristic landed. We also enabled the new fused-attn compile flag in the last build. First-call compile & some fallback cases show large stalls.

jess: Support has a high-priority ticket (#4209) — customer saw multiple timeouts. We need mitigation plan asap.

deploy-bot: Deployment matt/optimize-kernels succeeded at 6551233980.

sara: Immediate mitigation options: 1) route chat-api to legacy kernel-variant, 2) disable fused-attn compile flag, 3) throttle new path and canary. Which is quickest?

liang: I can flip runtime heuristic to prefer legacy for the chat-api route (cheap, fast). I will canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% if signals look good.

matt: Repro steps I used locally:

```
# reproduce p99 load snippet
export RW_API_KEY=redacted
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long context test"}],"max_tokens":512}' | jq .
```

Notes: with `--repeat 1000` the tail stabilizes; adding `RW_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1` shows many `kernel_fallback` logs.

liang: Applying heuristic change now: POST /api/admin/runtime/heuristic?route=chat-api&prefer=legacy (canary=10%).

deploy-bot: Heuristic update applied at 6551234520 by liang. Canary=10%.

sara: Watching metrics — p95 trending down, p99 already improving on the canary subset. Good signal.

matt: Also tried disabling `fused-attn` compile flag in a local build — latency tail improved but overall throughput dropped ~8%. Tradeoff acceptable for emergency rollback.

liang: If canary stays good for 15m I'll ramp to 50% then 100%. Will also add a short-term rule: if p99 > 3s for 5m auto-route to legacy.

jess: Noted for support ticket — updating customer: we have a mitigation in flight (routing to legacy kernel), ETA for full mitigation ~30–45m.

sara: Post-mortem action items: add an automated check that flags first-call compile stalls, add a regression test for kernel selection heuristics on long-context workloads, and a metric to surface `kernel_fallback` logs in the alerting stack.

matt: Filed playbook task: NEXUS-1425 (kernel-selection rollback automation + longseq test). Also will open a follow-up to investigate compile-time caching for fused kernels to avoid first-call spikes.

liang: Canary ramped to 50% at 6551234580; p95/p99 stable. Proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Heuristic ramp completed to 100% at 6551234592.

sara: P95/p99 back to baseline on chat-api. Closing immediate incident. Recommend a hotfix patch (disable fused-attn by default) and scheduled perf review.

jess: I updated ticket #4209 with timeline and customer compensation options.

matt: Thanks all — please add any remaining notes to NEXUS-1425 and mark follow-ups for the perf team. :thumbsup:
